question: Should OpenClaw adopt this permanent Microsoft Teams multi-account contract, including root-setting inheritance, account-specific identity and webhook requirements, defaultAccount selection, and continued support for legacy root-level bot credentials?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and proven, but these choices create durable public config, upgrade, credential-routing, setup, and persisted-state semantics that require explicit owner sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor and land
options.body: Approve the proposed account and compatibility contract, then require a current-main rebase and refreshed exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Request a smaller permanent surface, such as explicit per-account configuration without inherited security-sensitive settings or with a defined legacy deprecation plan.

options.title: Decline multi-account Teams
options.body: Reject this product direction and close both this PR and the associated feature issue with the supported multi-instance alternative.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and land
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed account and compatibility contract, then require a current-main rebase and refreshed exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person as the lead maintainer, and the decision spans product direction, public configuration, channel behavior, and upgrade compatibility.
